text: hello. the last worker just landed a really nice elevator. i also had them make some windows and door ways but those didnt land as well. so il let you take over from here. let me show you where it is at visually. [Image #6] so this is what it looks like in iso3d editor for making buildings. looks decent. the doors are a bit confusing here but whats important is that there are doors and windows. great. so then press compile and load in. and here is where it is [Image #7] D: oh dear lol. well, one thing for sure. the storefront glass works, but it always has. so i guess thats still something lol [Image #8] now atleast, maybe the doors are still here[Image #9] and turns out the answer is yes, on the open doorway, i can stand in the wall and walk through it. so it is hollow but visually its a hidden wall. which, is actually kinda cool for secrets, so maybe we can save that but for functional doorways it isnt. now in terms of door behavior, it just needs to either be an open arch for a door or at least a minecraft like door. simple two state machine, open and closed. now, with that there is also just various door types you can do. you could do store-front glass sliding doors that detect player / npc and open close automatically. you can do a normal front door, you can do a garage door, all of them can work. windows should be a lot easier to handle, we already have working glass and we have seen working walls with windows like so in the editor. thanks
resolution: Doors and windows now survive the compile end to end. Root cause of the hidden-wall doorway: compile/worldGeometry.ts carried private wall/stairs/elevator decomposition copies that never read piece.edit, so door/window walls baked as solid slabs while colliders shipped the opening. Fixed structurally (6e68c04ac): the bake now lowers the SAME pieceVisualShapes the editor renders — cutouts, jambs, glass panes (translucent materials), skins, miters all arrive as drawn; hand-mirrored copies (MATERIAL_COLOR/ALPHA, pushStairs/Elevator/SkinnedWall) deleted. Door semantics fixed at the shared source: panel only for interaction edits, sized by PLACED_TUNING so render IS the collider; arch genuinely open, garage panel fills its 2.6m opening. Then the two-state machine landed in the compiled game (b1facc1d2): DOORS lump (MAP_LUMP 19) + live rect/node per door in world_loader.zig — E opens/closes, closed blocks body and eye, open is clear; startOpen honors authored state. Proofs: worldParity 15/15, worldDoors 6/6, all 96 hmsc-int TS suites green, rjit game shot GREEN on coastal-town ('[loader] door layer: 2 live door(s)'). Deferred by name: open/close travel animation, auto-sliding storefront glass (new WallEdit row), door sounds.
